description: Member planning surface where users save products, news, deals, schemes, and agent suggestions onto a clear board with calendar view. Distinct from Customer Hub (discovery home) and Buildings dashboard (ops). Agents suggest and hand off; the desk owns the plan.
principles: Organisation Desk = plan & arrange; Customer Hub = discover; Buildings = ops
One card model for every saved item (typed: product, news, deal, scheme, module, note, suggestion)
Calendar is a view of dated cards — not a separate product
Reuse shortlist + member saved-items before inventing a CRM
Empty states are honest — never fake a filled plan
Calm desk UI — clear cards, light calendar; not another dark ops dashboard clone

waves.name: Add to desk from agents + content module
Drag, week agenda, Ask agent, Hub bridge

userStories.title: Organisation Desk shell
userStories.description: As a member, I want a single clean desk page so I can organise saved items without opening seven tools.
acceptanceCriteria: HTML at HTMLS GWM GWB/greenways-organisation-desk.html
Route GET /greenways/organisation-desk (and optional -embed)
Header explains desk vs Customer Hub; link to Customer Hub and Orchestra
Wix no-scroll meta; usable desktop and mobile
Demo mode works without login via localStorage

userStories.title: Typed desk cards + board columns
userStories.description: As a planner, I want saved items as cards I can move between Inbox, This week, Later, and Done.
acceptanceCriteria: localStorage key greenways-organisation-desk-v1 stores array of cards
Card shape: id, type, title, href, sourceAgent, status, date, note, refId, addedAt
Types: product | news | deal | scheme | module | note | suggestion
Statuses: inbox | planned | later | done map to board columns
User can add a quick note card; edit status; remove card
Shared JS: HTMLS GWM GWB/js/greenways-organisation-desk.js

userStories.title: Month / week calendar strip
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a calendar view of dated cards so the desk doubles as a simple plan board.
acceptanceCriteria: Month strip shows days; cards with date appear on that day
Clicking a day filters or highlights matching cards
User can set or clear a card date from the card UI
Undated cards stay on board only (not forced onto calendar)

userStories.title: Import shortlist + Customer Hub bridge
userStories.description: As a shopper, I want products I already shortlisted to land on my desk Inbox in one action.
acceptanceCriteria: Import from sessionStorage greenways-product-shortlist creates product cards (dedupe by refId)
Customer Hub links to /greenways/organisation-desk
Desk empty state offers Import shortlist and Open Customer Hub

userStories.title: Add to desk from agent product cards
userStories.description: As a user chatting with Artemis or Zyanne, I want Add to desk on product sample cards without leaving chat.
acceptanceCriteria: Product sample cards show Add to desk control (alongside shortlist where present)
Writes product card with sourceAgent slug/name
Toast confirms; optional Open desk link
Wired on equipment-agent and sustainable-products-agent at minimum

userStories.title: Content module + Quick link
userStories.description: As an agent user, I want Organisation Desk available as a content module / quick link.
acceptanceCriteria: Module id organisation-desk in data/greenways-content-modules.json
Listed for equipment, products, finance, grants, deals, media
AGENTS.md key file row for desk page + PRD

userStories.title: Member persist (optional)
userStories.description: As a logged-in member, I want my desk to survive across devices when auth is present.
acceptanceCriteria: When member auth present, attempt sync with GET/POST /api/members/saved-items or dedicated desk endpoint
localStorage remains offline fallback
No silent wipe of local cards on failed API

userStories.title: Agent suggestion inbox
userStories.description: As a member, I want agent handoffs / suggestions to appear as suggestion cards I can accept onto the board.
acceptanceCriteria: Handoff or structured suggestion payload can create type=suggestion cards
Accept moves to planned; Dismiss removes
Attributed with agent portrait when roster data available

userStories.title: Add to desk — news, deals, schemes
userStories.description: As a planner, I want to save Cheryce news, Zara deals, and Andrieus schemes onto the desk — not only products.
acceptanceCriteria: Cheryce banner news/module cards expose Add to desk (type=news)
Zara banner deal cards expose Add to desk (type=deal)
Andrieus scheme tablets expose Add to desk (type=scheme; deadline → date when present)
Quick links include Organisation Desk on media, deals, and grants agents

userStories.title: Drag cards between columns
userStories.description: As a planner, I want to drag desk cards between Inbox, This week, Later, and Done.
acceptanceCriteria: Cards are draggable on the Organisation Desk board
Dropping on a column updates status and re-renders
Status dropdown still works as fallback

userStories.title: This week agenda strip
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a week list under the month calendar so dated cards are easy to scan.
acceptanceCriteria: Week strip shows Mon–Sun for the current week with card titles
Copy this week exports a plain-text plan to the clipboard
Clicking a week item focuses that date on the board

userStories.title: Ask agent from a desk card
userStories.description: As a planner, I want one tap to ask the right specialist about a saved card.
acceptanceCriteria: Each board card has Ask [Agent] linking to /greenways/{slug}?q=…
Routing prefers sourceAgent, then type defaults (news→Cheryce, deal→Zara, scheme→Andrieus, product→Artemis)

userStories.title: Customer Hub → Add to desk
userStories.description: As a member on Customer Hub, I want to send Saved items to Organisation Desk without re-searching.
acceptanceCriteria: Saved lane cards show Add to desk / On desk toggle
Writes product cards into greenways-organisation-desk-v1
Toast offers Open desk

outOfScopeV1: Buildings KPI / sensor clone on the desk
Replacing Customer Hub or Agent Market
